assertions.summary: The heartbeat file contained changing parseable UTC timestamps two seconds apart.

evidence.command: for n in 1 2; do printf '%s\n' "-- observation $n"; date -u '+observer_utc=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ epoch=%s'; if [ -r /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat ]; then stat -c 'size=%s mtime_epoch=%Y' /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat; printf 'content='; sed -n '1p' /run/telemetry-heartbeat/heartbeat; else printf '%s\n' 'heartbeat=ABSENT'; fi; if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then sleep 2; fi; done
